For someone under 18

India
Report a cyber concern

The National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal is the official online entry point for cybercrime complaints.

cybercrime.gov.in
Checked 2026-10-19 · review by 2026-11-18
Human verification pending
Scope and eligibility

For cybercrime concerns. The official portal determines the applicable reporting route.

What to know

Authentication and complaint requirements belong to the portal. No complaint is filed here. Direct availability is not guaranteed.
